replication.target_description: Closest located analysis is IES-I intrusiveness predicting follow-up BDI-II among 33 untreated mixed-community participants with a baseline intrusive memory, controlling baseline BDI-II; not restricted to current depression.

n.sample_role: Untreated follow-up participants reporting an intrusive memory at baseline.
n.exclusions: Initial sample 121; 36 excluded for clinical eligibility; 85 eligible at baseline and 64 followed up. Twenty-three treated between assessments excluded from this analysis.

es.location: p.542 (PDF p.5), Untreated participants; rendered primary page verified

p.location: p.542 (PDF p.5), Untreated participants; rendered primary page verified

notes: PDF target pages rendered and checked: canonical TXT control glyphs misencode equals, minus and greater-than signs and beta as b. Quotes preserve canonical TXT; numeric values and p bounds follow the rendered primary PDF. Known sample mismatch: the supplied locator describes participants with current depression; this primary article reports mixed-community/untreated samples, with no current-depression-only target test located. The extracted statistics describe the explicitly named closest analysis; they do not verify the requested depressed subgroup. Reported success for that target remains unestablished.
